data.name: Depths
data.detailed_description:
Depths is a casual "friend-slop" cooperative experience where you and up to three friends descend into the mines on behalf of the Dwarven Mining Company. Your mission is simple: collect gems, meet your quota, and make it back alive. The last part is optional.

Navigate a procedurally generated maze of caves, avoid environmental hazards, and try not to become a goblin's lunch. At least one of you needs to make it back with the loot, so choose wisely who gets left behind. Each dive is different, each quota is higher, and the company's patience is finite. Don't disappoint the suits upstairs.

FEATURES:

DWARVES!

Cool little guys. That's it. That's the feature.

PROCEDURALLY GENERATED CAVES

No two dives are the same. New layouts, new loot, new ways to get hopelessly lost and blame your teammates.

PROXIMITY CHAT

Coordinate with your team, panic together, or simply scream into the void as something chases you. Your call.

PLAY YOUR WAY

Full online co-op with lobby searching and hosting, or go it alone in offline singleplayer if you have no friends (we don't judge).

EVIL ENEMIES

  • Greedy little goblins who want your gold and will not hesitate to take it

  • Creepy little spiders (ew)

SHOP AND ITEMS

Spend your hard earned gold on trinkets and tools between dives. We encourage you to participate in our beautiful capitalistic society. The Dwarven Mining Company thanks you for your consumption.

LEGALLY REQUIRED EMPLOYEE BENEFITS (Minigames!)

The company, in full compliance with local labor law, provides a recreational area featuring basketball, soccer, and a full playground. Employees are permitted up to 15 minutes of leisure time per shift. After that, get back to work. The quota won't fill itself.

data.short_description: Depths is a cooperative multiplayer game where you and up to three friends​ delve into procedurally generated caves, collecting items,​ going deeper, making sure to meet quota every dive. Avoid the monsters that dwell in these caverns​ if you and your friends hope to make it out alive.​

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 or RX 6600 XT
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 or RX 7600xt or equivalent
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
